verdict.rationale: MoonPay's enterprise page says it offers fiat-backed stablecoin issuance infrastructure, so this axis applies. The pack has no documentation of reserve composition, attestations, or any yield or rewards program with eligibility and regulatory caveats. Saying the coins are 'fiat-backed' is not a reserve disclosure.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the economics of held stablecoins are documented — reserve composition, attestations, and any yield or rewards program with its eligibility and regulatory caveats stated plainly
